SAP VC/AVC Functional Consultant – SAP SD & PP Integration

Corporate • Bangalore - Hybrid • 1 Open Position

Dear Sonti Naveen,

A new job opening has officially been uploaded and published on the OKLUT Careers & Recruitment Portal! As part of our active Employee Referral Program, we encourage all team members to refer outstanding professionals from their network or explore internal career advancement.

Official Job Code
JOB-SAP-AC02
Employee Referral Code
REF-SAPAC02
Department: Corporate
Work Location: Bangalore - Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time
Available Vacancies: 1 Position(s)

Role Overview & Responsibilities

Client: JP Tokyo. We are looking for an experienced SAP Variant Configuration (VC) / Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC) Functional Consultant with strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and cross-functional integration with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and Production Planning (PP). The candidate will be responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting configurable-product processes, including Configure-to-Order (CTO) and Make-to-Order (MTO) scenarios. Experience in migration from LO-VC to AVC will be an added advantage.

Key Qualifications & Skills

• Strong hands-on experience in SAP Variant Configuration (LO-VC) and/or Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC). • Strong knowledge of characteristics, classes, configuration profiles, and object dependencies. • Experience with Super BOMs, Super Routings, variant tables, and configuration logic. • Good functional knowledge of SAP SD and SAP PP integration. • Understanding of Configure-to-Order (CTO) and Make-to-Order (MTO) processes. • Experience with SAP S/4HANA. • Knowledge of sales order processing, configurable materials, pricing, MRP, and production orders. • Ability to troubleshoot issues across VC/AVC, SD, and PP. • Experience in functional design, configuration, testing, and UAT. • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills. • Experience in LO-VC to AVC migration is an added advantage. • Exposure to MM, FI/CO, and manufacturing integration is preferred.
🎁

How to Refer & Earn Your Employee Bonus

Every successful hire through employee referral is eligible for attractive referral rewards disbursed with your monthly payroll.

  1. Share the Job Code (JOB-SAP-AC02) and Referral Code (REF-SAPAC02) with your candidate.
  2. Ask them to enter your referral code when applying on the Careers Portal.
  3. Our Talent Acquisition team will prioritize their screening and keep you posted!
View Careers Portal → Internal HR Portal
